annotations.title: Stablecoin transfers on x402 rails, by evidence tier

description: Stablecoin transfers on x402 rails over a window you choose (default the last 24 hours), from how many paying addresses to how many receiving ones, by token and network, in four DISJOINT evidence classes: confirmed (the protocol’s own settlement event or payload), inferred (an identified x402 facilitator), candidate (only a shape x402 requires: a Solana memo beside a transfer into a listed seller, or a transfer to a catalogued payTo; compatible with x402, not proof) and unclassified; total = their sum. The strict figure is `confirmedPayments`; `payments` includes the candidates. LEAD WITH `lead`: confirmed, inferred, candidate and the watermark; `evidenceTiers` is the same split under the tier names every tool uses (confirmed_protocol, inferred_facilitator, candidate_catalogue, unknown). Filter by stablecoin (USDC) or network. Free. No class shows what was bought, that it was delivered, or that an AI paid.
name: stablecoin_payments

byEvidence.description: Per network and evidence value (memo, facilitator, catalogued_payee, permit2-proxy, payload): payments, what it means, its evidenceClass and evidenceLevel, and every signal the classifier tested (signals, notProof). Null where the stored window predates the split.

byTokenAndNetwork.description: Per token and network: payments, payers, payees, amount.

confirmedPayments.description: The strict figure: transfers carrying the x402 protocol’s own settlement trace (evidenceClasses.confirmed). Null where the split is not known for this selection (e.g. a token filter on a stored window), never zero.

coverage.description: What is counted, matching the filter: the classes included and what is left out.

evidenceClasses.description: known, total, confirmed, inferred, candidate, unclassified (disjoint; total = sum; null where not known), reconciled, bySignal (per evidence value: class, level, label, payments), levels (1 compatible shape … 5 evidenced delivery), attributedRequests and evidencedDeliveries (always null: no on-chain reader reaches them), means, provenance.

evidenceTiers.description: Since 2026-11-27: {known, total, confirmed_protocol, inferred_facilitator, candidate_catalogue, unknown}, summing to payments; the tier vocabulary every tool uses.

lead.description: Since 2026-11-27: confirmed, inferred and candidate first, then the watermark the count is read through.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

payments.description: Every counted transfer, candidates included: confirmed + inferred + candidate + unclassified. Not the strict figure (that is confirmedPayments); kept under this name for compatibility.

says.description: The answer, "Partial: ..." first where the window is not all read, then confirmed, inferred and candidate apart.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it, each {code, message, says} with message and says the same sentence. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.

window.description: The window asked for against the window read (2026-11-27): state complete | partial | not_read, requested {from, to, seconds}, covered {from, to, seconds} or null, coveredShare, watermark (how far the slowest source is read), backlog [{chain, seconds, fromStart?}] (unread end and start per network), firstLine. Where state is not complete, `says` starts with firstLine ("Partial: ..."); counts in the unread part are missing, not zero.

title: Stablecoin transfers on x402 rails, by evidence tier
